title: Mixer output reaches a chest
question: How do I set up a brass mixer that puts the brass into a chest?
player: Has a water wheel, a basin, a mixer, a chest and a funnel.
rubric: Mixer turns at 30 RPM or more (gears up a water wheel)
Output goes onto a depot or belt, or into a sneak-placed funnel on top of the chest beside and one down from the basin
